title: Evaluating Text Style Transfer: A Nine-Language Benchmark for Text Detoxification
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical development and benchmarking of automatic evaluation metrics (such as XCOMET and SIM-PROD) for text detoxification across multiple languages. While detoxification involves the removal of toxic language—a category defined by social and ethical norms—the research is centered on the performance and correlation of evaluation metrics (fluency, content preservation, style accuracy) rather than an evaluation or benchmarking of religious frameworks, moral systems, or ethical theories.
